links.outcome: TNM staging accuracy of optimized GLM-4-Air versus GPT-4o on held-out test set
links.quote: It achieved higher staging accuracies on the black-box test set: 92% (95% CI 0.850-0.959) for T, 86% (95% CI 0.779-0.915) for N, 92% (95% CI 0.850-0.959) for distant metastasis status (M), and 90% for overall clinical staging; by comparison, GPT-4o attained 87% (95% CI 0.790-0.922), 70% (95% CI 0.604-0.781), 78% (95% CI 0.689-0.850), and 80%, respectively.

unlisted_practices: Prompt engineering with chain-of-thought and domain knowledge injection plus supervised fine-tuning (LoRA) to improve LLM clinical staging accuracy
Clinical impact classification of staging errors by severity (category I errors)

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks an LLM fine-tuning and prompt-engineering pipeline for automated TNM staging on a retrospective dataset of imaging reports, evaluating diagnostic/classification accuracy without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or clinical workflow intervention.
